pillars.name: Mobility & assistive devices
pillars.summary: Facilitating access to wheelchairs, white canes, artificial limbs and other mobility support.
pillars.featured_example: A pupil at Kaling Primary School, previously carried roughly 3km to school, was provided with a wheelchair.

pillars.name: Inclusive education
pillars.summary: Helping children with disabilities overcome barriers to school access and participation.

pillars.name: School water & sanitation
pillars.summary: Supporting water tanks, rainwater harvesting and sanitation initiatives in schools.

pillars.name: Eye health
pillars.summary: Connecting people requiring eye care with organisations and facilities able to provide assistance.

pillars.name: Community support
pillars.summary: Mobilising resources and practical assistance for people facing difficult circumstances.

pillars.name: Shelter & housing support
pillars.summary: Helping vulnerable families move from makeshift shelter toward decent, durable housing.
pillars.featured_example: A family was supported from an initial visit through material delivery, construction and furnishing of a rebuilt home; the household's wheelchair-using member was present throughout. 7 photos on file in /projects/shelter-housing.

note: Individual dated project case studies will be added under /projects/<pillar-id>/ as documentation is confirmed.
